parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.creator_key)
  r.creator_key,
  r.canonical_handle,
  r.monitoring_interval_hours,
  i.identity_key,
  i.provider,
  i.identity_state,
  i.evidence_state
FROM influencer_intelligence.creator_registry r
JOIN influencer_intelligence.creator_identity i
  ON i.creator_key = r.creator_key
WHERE r.monitoring_enabled = true
  AND r.registry_state = 'candidate'
  AND i.identity_state = 'active'
  AND i.evidence_state = 'observed'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM influencer_intelligence.creator_profile_snapshot s
    WHERE s.creator_key = r.creator_key
      AND s.observed_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => r.monitoring_interval_hours)
  )
ORDER BY r.creator_key,
  CASE i.provider WHEN 'meta-graph' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  i.observed_at DESC NULLS LAST,
  i.retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { event_type: 'snapshot_scheduler_skipped', event_version: 'influencer-intelligence/snapshot-result/v1', status: 'skipped', reason: 'feature_flag_off', no_provider_call: true } }];
